title: rhinanthus angustifolius subsp. lanceolatus
intro: Rhinanthus angustifolius subsp. lanceolatus, commonly known as lance-leaved yellow rattle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants, often grasses. The lance-leaved yellow rattle is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
